servers.description: The original path. Every deployment serves it.
The versioned path: the same implementation, the same versions and the same credentials. Generated clients move to it in a later release.

get.description: Reads records through CoreEdge from the customer's SAP system, through the connection bound to this credential's environment. An empty result is a 200 with an empty array and MUST be treated as 'no records', which is different from 'not set up' (403) and from an error (5xx).

200.description: Records, or an empty array meaning 'no records' — not an error.

400.description: The interface cannot be read as configured: it names no entity set, or its service could not be resolved. Fix the configuration in Studio — do not retry. Or UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: the CoreEdge-Version header names a version this deployment does not serve (unknown, or retired at its Sunset date); error.supportedVersions lists what may be sent, and nothing ran. Codes: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the request or the interface. Do not retry unchanged.
Send one of error.supportedVersions, or omit the header to be served the default. Do not retry unchanged.

403.description: Not set up: no approved access grant for this interface in this environment, a deprecated interface, or the customer's connection is not bound yet. Codes: FORBIDDEN, CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIGURED.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix access in Studio. Do not retry.
Ask the customer to finish connecting their SAP system. Do not retry.

404.description: NOT_FOUND. No interface with this id belongs to the solution this token was issued for, or the tenant answered that the interface's entity set does not exist. A configuration fault — do not retry. Codes: NOT_FOUND.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the interface id or its configuration. Do not retry.

502.description: The tenant or the connection's token endpoint failed. Distinct from an empty result; retrying may help. Codes: UPSTREAM_ERROR.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Retry or escalate with the correlation id.

504.description: The tenant or the connection's token endpoint did not answer in time; retrying may help. Codes: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Retry; for a write, retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

get.description: The interface's request and response schemas, and where they came from (the service's own description, sampled rows, or none). Makes no SAP call.

404.description: No such interface for this solution. Codes: NOT_FOUND.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the interface id or its configuration. Do not retry.

post.description: Creates one record in the customer's SAP system. Requires the solution's write key beside the bearer token, and an Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and payload is answered from the stored outcome (Idempotency-Replayed: true) and never writes twice.

201.description: Created. A replay of an earlier outcome under the same Idempotency-Key carries Idempotency-Replayed: true and the original status and body.

400.description: The request or the interface's definition cannot be used: a missing or malformed Idempotency-Key, a body that is not { record }, an `entity` that differs from the interface's dataset, no dataset, or an own service not yet verified in this environment. Or UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: the CoreEdge-Version header names a version this deployment does not serve (unknown, or retired at its Sunset date); error.supportedVersions lists what may be sent, and nothing ran. Codes: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the request or the interface. Do not retry unchanged.
Send one of error.supportedVersions, or omit the header to be served the default. Do not retry unchanged.

403.description: Not set up: a missing or invalid write key, no approved WRITE grant in this environment, an interface that is not ACTIVE, writes disabled on the connection, or the connection is not bound. Codes: FORBIDDEN, CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIGURED.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix access in Studio. Do not retry.
Ask the customer to finish connecting their SAP system. Do not retry.

404.description: No such interface for this solution, or the dataset does not exist on the tenant. Codes: NOT_FOUND.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the interface id or its configuration. Do not retry.

409.description: The Idempotency-Key was used with a different payload or destination; or, with Retry-After, the first request under it is still running — retry with the same key. Codes: CONFLICT.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: With Retry-After: retry with the SAME key after it. Without: use a new key for a different write.

422.description: SAP rejected the record. Fix the payload; do not retry unchanged. Codes: VALIDATION_ERROR.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the request or the interface. Do not retry unchanged.

502.description: The tenant or the token endpoint failed. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key. Codes: UPSTREAM_ERROR.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Retry or escalate with the correlation id.

504.description: The tenant or the token endpoint did not answer in time. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key: the stored outcome answers if the first attempt landed. Codes: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Retry; for a write, retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

404.description: No such interface for this solution. Codes: NOT_FOUND.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Fix the interface id or its configuration. Do not retry.

get.summary: List the interfaces this credential's solution defines
get.description: Metadata only; makes no SAP call. `callable` says whether a data call would be made, and `refusal` why not.

get.summary: List the northbound API versions and the deprecation policy
get.description: The changelog as JSON: which versions exist, which this deployment serves, which one an unpinned request gets, and when each is deprecated or sunset. Needs no credential; reads nothing but the deployment's own version registry.

bearerAuth.description: Per-solution client token issued in Developer Studio. During a rotation's overlap window the replaced key keeps working; after it, it answers 401 like any unknown key.

writeKey.name: X-CoreEdge-Write-Key
writeKey.description: The solution's write credential — a second secret, so a leaked read token cannot write.

UnsupportedVersion.description: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: the CoreEdge-Version header names a version this deployment does not serve (unknown, or retired at its Sunset date). Refused before anything else; error.supportedVersions lists what may be sent. Send one of them, or omit the header. Codes: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Send one of error.supportedVersions, or omit the header to be served the default. Do not retry unchanged.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, unknown, revoked, expired or rotated-out client token — one answer for all of them. Codes: UNAUTHENTICATED.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Use a current key from Developer Studio. Do not retry with the same key.

RateLimited.description: Rate limited: this credential's budget, or the caller's address. Codes: RATE_LIMITED, RATE_LIMITED_ADDRESS, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Back off for Retry-After seconds.
Back off for Retry-After seconds; backing off one key may not help.
Back off for Retry-After seconds; send the client token on every call.

LimiterUnavailable.description: The rate limiter could not be asked; nothing reached SAP. Codes: LIMITER_UNAVAILABLE.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Retry after Retry-After seconds.

SapUnavailable.description: Refused before anything reached SAP: the rate limiter could not be asked, the SAP system's circuit breaker is open, or the bound connection is served by a Tenant Twin this deployment does not have. Codes: LIMITER_UNAVAILABLE, CIRCUIT_OPEN, CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIGURED.

x-coreedge-error-codes.action: Retry after Retry-After seconds.
Retry after Retry-After seconds; for a write, retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
Ask the customer to finish connecting their SAP system. Do not retry.
Escalate with the correlation id.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: How many records to return. The broker clamps it to 1–100.

CoreEdgeVersion.name: CoreEdge-Version
CoreEdgeVersion.description: The northbound API version to be served, one of the versions this API has had (2026-10). Omit it to be served the oldest version still supported, which keeps code written before it behaving as it was written. A version this deployment does not serve is refused with 400 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION. The versions and their dates: GET /versions.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every write. Reuse the same key when retrying the same write; a new write takes a new key. Kept for 24 hours.

CorrelationId.description: Quote this when raising a support request; it identifies the audit row for this call.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Calls left in this credential's current window (the smaller of its own budget and its address's backstop).

InterfaceStatus.description: Present, with the value DRAFT, when the interface is still a draft in Developer Studio. A draft is served — premature is not wrong — but its contract may still change. Absent once the interface is ACTIVE.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: "true" when this answer is the stored outcome of an earlier request under the same Idempotency-Key.

CacheControl.description: Always no-store: customer data never sits in a shared cache.

CoreEdgeVersion.description: The northbound API version that served this answer: the one the request pinned, or the default. Absent only on 400 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, which no version served.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745: present once the serving version's deprecation is announced, as @<unix seconds> of its deprecation date. Move to a newer version before its Sunset; /api/northbound/versions says which.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594: the HTTP-date from which the serving version is refused, once announced.

Link.description: With Deprecation or Sunset: </api/northbound/versions>; rel="deprecation" and rel="sunset", the changelog.

APartner.title: Business Partner
APartner.description: A A_Partner record as the service returns it, compiled from the service's own description.

APartner_Create.title: Business Partner (create)
APartner_Create.description: The record a create sends to A_Partner. Computed and non-creatable properties are left out; required lists what the service marks mandatory. A navigation may carry related records to create with it (a deep insert).

to_Address.description: Related API_PARTNER_DEMO.A_PartnerAddressType records to create with this one.

to_Customer.description: A related API_PARTNER_DEMO.A_CustomerType record to create with this one, or a link to an existing one.

APartner_Update.title: Business Partner (update)
APartner_Update.description: The changes an update sends to one A_Partner record (PATCH semantics: send only what changes). Keys, computed, immutable and non-updatable properties are left out.

APartner_Key.title: Business Partner (key)
APartner_Key.description: The key that names one A_Partner record.

empty.description: True when the service answered successfully and had nothing to return. This is data, not a failure.

note.description: A one-line, human-readable account of what came back.

APartner2.title: Business Partner
APartner2.description: A A_Partner record as the service returns it, compiled from the service's own description.

APartner2_Create.title: Business Partner (create)
APartner2_Create.description: The record a create sends to A_Partner. Computed and non-creatable properties are left out; required lists what the service marks mandatory. A navigation may carry related records to create with it (a deep insert).

to_Address.description: Related API_PARTNER_DEMO.A_PartnerAddressType records to create with this one.

to_Customer.description: A related API_PARTNER_DEMO.A_CustomerType record to create with this one, or a link to an existing one.

APartner2_Update.title: Business Partner (update)
APartner2_Update.description: The changes an update sends to one A_Partner record (PATCH semantics: send only what changes). Keys, computed, immutable and non-updatable properties are left out.

APartner2_Key.title: Business Partner (key)
APartner2_Key.description: The key that names one A_Partner record.

entity.description: Accepted for older clients, never obeyed: the dataset is part of the interface's definition. Sent and different from it, the write is refused with 400.

location.description: The created record's identity after the service root, e.g. /A_BusinessPartner('1000123'). Never a host.

defaultVersion.description: What a request without the header is served.

version.description: The governed contract version that served this call.

requestSchema.description: The JSON Schema of a write's `record`, compiled from the service's description; null for a read interface or when none is compiled.

responseSchema.description: The schema captured from sampled rows of this contract, or null.

responseSchemaOmitted.description: Present when `responseSchema` is null for a capture of this contract that is stored: it is larger than a captured schema may be.

contract.description: The compiled contract and where it came from.

schemas.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 documents: record, create, update, key.

schemasOmitted.description: Present when `schemas` is null for a contract that is recorded: TOO_LARGE, it is larger than a generated document may carry; NOT_RENDERED, its schemas were not rendered when it was recorded, and verifying the service again renders them.

Error.description: The one error envelope every CoreEdge northbound answer uses. Branch on `code`; quote `correlationId`.

message.description: A sentence for a person. Never a host, a URL or SAP's raw answer.

correlationId.description: Identifies the audit row for this call.

requestedVersion.description: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION only: the CoreEdge-Version value the request sent.

supportedVersions.description: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION only: the versions this deployment serves, oldest (the default) first.

UNAUTHENTICATED.meaning: The client token is missing, unknown, inactive, revoked or expired, was replaced by a rotation whose overlap has closed, or belongs to a retired solution. One answer for all of them, deliberately.
UNAUTHENTICATED.action: Use a current key from Developer Studio. Do not retry with the same key.

FORBIDDEN.meaning: Not set up: no approved, unexpired, unrevoked grant for this interface in this environment (or one approved before grants were bound to an interface, which needs re-approval), a deprecated interface, a missing or invalid write key, writes disabled on the connection, or the SAP system refused the connection's credential.
FORBIDDEN.action: Fix access in Studio. Do not retry.

CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIGURED.meaning: 403: the customer's SAP connection cannot be bound for this credential's environment yet. 503: the bound connection is served by the Tenant Twin and no twin answers on this deployment; nothing reached SAP (P0.14).
CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIGURED.action: Ask the customer to finish connecting their SAP system. Do not retry.

NOT_FOUND.meaning: No interface with this id belongs to the solution this token was issued for, or the SAP system answered that the dataset does not exist.
NOT_FOUND.action: Fix the interface id or its configuration. Do not retry.

VALIDATION_ERROR.meaning: 400: the request or the interface's definition cannot be used as it stands (no dataset, an invalid service path, a missing Idempotency-Key, a body that is not { record }, an unverified own service), or a query that cannot be served as sent: a parameter outside the query grammar, a value not of its field's type, a cursor that cannot be used or was sent with other parameters than its first page, an interface that serves no queries (error.query.rule says which). 422: SAP rejected the record itself; also, SAP rejected the query, one record is larger than the page limit, or SAP's page was larger than CoreEdge reads. 413: the answer is larger than CoreEdge can return.
VALIDATION_ERROR.action: Fix the request or the interface. Do not retry unchanged.

POLICY_FIELD_NOT_GRANTED.meaning: The query asks for what the interface's query policy does not allow: a field it may not read, filter or sort on, an operator, key lookup, a count, a page size above its maximum, or a query without a filter the policy or SAP requires. error.query names the rule, the field and what is allowed. Nothing was sent to SAP (P1.4).
POLICY_FIELD_NOT_GRANTED.action: Change the query within the interface's query policy, or ask its builder to allow it. Do not retry unchanged.

CURSOR_STALE.meaning: The paging cursor has expired (15 minutes per cursor, 2 hours per paging run), or the interface, its query policy, its grant or its connection changed since the first page (P1.4).
CURSOR_STALE.action: Start the read again from the first page.

RECORD_NOT_FOUND.meaning: A key lookup found no record: SAP has none with this key (P1.4).
RECORD_NOT_FOUND.action: SAP has no record with this key. Not an error to retry.

CONFLICT.meaning: The Idempotency-Key was used before with a different payload or destination — or, with Retry-After, the first request under this key is still running.
CONFLICT.action: With Retry-After: retry with the SAME key after it. Without: use a new key for a different write.

RATE_LIMITED.meaning: This credential used its own per-minute budget.

RATE_LIMITED_ADDRESS.meaning: The caller's address is over a limit (the edge's per-address backstop, or too many unrecognised keys from it). Another key on a shared egress may have spent it.
RATE_LIMITED_ADDRESS.action: Back off for Retry-After seconds; backing off one key may not help.

RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.meaning: The caller's address is over the edge's ordinary per-address limit (300 GET or 120 POST a minute), which a call meets when no per-credential limit applies: GET /versions, a call with no Authorization header, or every call while per-credential limits are switched off.
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.action: Back off for Retry-After seconds; send the client token on every call.

LIMITER_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The rate limiter could not be asked, so the call was refused for safety. Nothing reached SAP.

CIRCUIT_OPEN.meaning: The circuit breaker for the SAP system behind the bound connection is open after repeated failures to answer, so the call was refused before anything was sent to SAP (P0.14). Sent only where the breaker enforces; a refused write releases its Idempotency-Key.
CIRCUIT_OPEN.action: Retry after Retry-After seconds; for a write, retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.meaning: The SAP system, or the connection's token endpoint, did not answer in time.
UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.action: Retry; for a write, retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

UPSTREAM_ERROR.meaning: The SAP system, or the connection's token endpoint, failed or answered in a way the broker could not use. With error.query.rule UPSTREAM_IGNORED_PAGING or KEY_NOT_UNIQUE, the service did not honour the paging CoreEdge asked for, or returned two records for one key: retrying does not help.
UPSTREAM_ERROR.action: Retry or escalate with the correlation id.

UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.meaning: The request's CoreEdge-Version header names a version this deployment does not serve: unknown, or retired at its Sunset date. Refused before the route does anything else (no credential check, no idempotency reservation, nothing sent to SAP); `error.supportedVersions` lists what may be sent (P1.10).
UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.action: Send one of error.supportedVersions, or omit the header to be served the default. Do not retry unchanged.

list.note: A write interface is not read through the data route.
